sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Jason was an ancient Greek hero and the leader of the [[Argonauts]] and was said to have been married to a sorceress, Madea. He was accompanied by the Argonauts on a quest to Colchis, modern day Georgia, prior to the Trojan War to find the Golden Fleece. {{source|wikipedia:Jason|Wikipedia}}

In the mission, [[Jason and the Argonauts]], [[Dante Vale]]'s team sought out to reach [[Velo, Greece|Velos, Greece]], find the magical flagship Argo, and retrieve Jason's log book and his [[Hoplite]] Titans. {{source|The Treasures of the Argonauts}}

full_text:
Jason was an ancient Seeker from Greece who featured prominently in Greek mythology. He led a team known as the Argonauts, a band of heroes and sailors.

== History ==
Jason was an ancient Greek hero and the leader of the Argonauts and was said to have been married to a sorceress, Madea. He was accompanied by the Argonauts on a quest to Colchis, modern day Georgia, prior to the Trojan War to find the Golden Fleece. [wikipedia:Jason]

In the mission, Jason and the Argonauts, Dante Vale's team sought out to reach Velos, Greece, find the magical flagship Argo, and retrieve Jason's log book and his Hoplite Titans. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

==Abilities==
Not much is known about Jason's abilities, although it can be presumed that they were a major asset in his quests during ancient history. He owned a tablet that was able to teach the spell Thoughtspecter, suggesting ties with his Titan Madea's illusory powers. 

=== Bonded Titans ===
* Hoplite x5
* Madea
